title: Form line-item table: people, multi-select, tags, check and rating columns get their own cell editors instead of a plain text box
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Follow-up from #36023 S5 (PR #36039, the form line-item table `GridField`). Under epic #35547.

## What happens today

The line-item table's column types are locked to nine by the public spec (`InlineGridColumnSchema.type` in `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`: text, number, currency, date, datetime, time, select, lookup, file). A child field of any other type is folded by `fieldTypeToColumnType` (`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/deriveMasterDetail.ts`) into a plain text box. Measured in the browser by the S5 thread:
- A people column takes only a raw user id typed by hand; no name, no picker. A wrong id is refused by the server (`reference_not_found`) and nothing is saved.
- A multi-select column holds one option only; "red, green" is refused (`invalid_option`).
- Check and rating fold the same way; boolean folds to a yes/no select, which is fine.

No bad value reaches the database; the cost is usability.

## To do

1. Add the missing column types to the spec's line-item column enum (people, multi-select, tags, check, rating), with the same cell editors the main list uses (S1/S2 in-cell faces). This is a spec change and takes its own contract review.
2. Until then, consider making those columns read-only in the line-item table with a hint to edit on the record page, so nobody types raw ids.
3. Pin each new column type in the line-item table's tests.

## Acceptance

- In a master-detail form, a people cell offers a searchable list of names, a multi-select cell holds several options, and check and rating cells behave as in the main list.

Blocked-by: #36039
